channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Chris Paul | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Chris Paul from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Carmelo Anthony on Chris Paul
item.description:
Carmelo Anthony:

“I think that Chris Paul got to let it go. Meaning, don't even sweat it. Let them sweat on it. Let them decide that. Let them figure that out. Continue doing what you're doing. Yeah, anybody who have an opportunity to have their jersey hung up in the rafter is going to want their jersey in the rafter. I think we make it seem like it's just so easy to get your jersey in the rafter. No, it's not easy to get your jersey in the rafter. It's about what you leave in this organization, the impact, the effect, not just the wins and losses. How you made people feel around here in the organization, the community, the city. It goes deeper than just banners.”

Carmelo Anthony on Chris Paul, Oct 8, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Patrick Beverley on Chris Paul, Rajon Rondo, James Harden, Russell Westbrook
item.description:
Patrick Beverley:

“I signed a three-year $40 million contract with the Clippers. I turned down a three-year $50 million with Sacramentojust to stay with the Clippers. For me to be there, all the great guards they've had, I was part of that starting five that helped the Clippers go to the first time ever Western Conference Finals. They've had great guards. They've had James Harden, they had Russell Westbrook, they have Chris Paul, they've had Rajon Rondo. They had a plethora of point guards that just can never help them get over the hump, but I was part of that starting five that helped them finally, first time ever, and they haven't been back since, get to the Western Conference Finals.”

Patrick Beverley on Chris Paul, Rajon Rondo, James Harden, Russell Westbrook, Sep 9, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Chris Paul, Steve Kerr, James Harden
item.description:
D'Antoni on the James Harden and Chris Paul Rockets:

“We thought we were the best team in the league by far that year for sure. And we had Golden State on the ropes, with their Big 3 -- Big 4, actually, they'll probably have four Hall-of-Fame guys going in. They were good, and Steve Kerr does a great job. We had 'em, you know? We had 'em, and just, Chris [Paul] got hurt, and that's just the way it goes. And then we missed 27 3s in a row, which didn't help. Analytically, I know that's not good! I knew it wasn't when we were doing it, but just a great team.”

Mike D'Antoni on Chris Paul, Steve Kerr, James Harden, Aug 14, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Channing Frye on Chris Paul, Allen Iverson
item.description:
Channing Frye:

“I think Allen Iverson is the one of the top three most influential players ever to play basketball. Butif we're looking at careers, Chris Paul's career is better than Allen Iverson's.”

Channing Frye on Chris Paul, Allen Iverson, Aug 8, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Chris Paul
item.description:
Justin Martinez:Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Chris Paul’s retirement:

“Honestly, it’s sad the way it’s happened. I thought he would get his flowers a little bit differently,but that’ll never change what he’s done for this game. I’m proud of him. He’s been special. Hopefully I can get to that level of mastering the game of basketball.”

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Chris Paul, Feb 14, 2026. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Blake Griffin on Chris Paul
item.description:
“He did that for us with the Clippers. Houston was sort of a different situation. He went to Phoenix and it was the first time in forever Phoenix really had true success, with Chris Paul at the point guard. Chris Paul left, and so Phoenix fizzled. CP was in San Antonio and sort of did the same thing. So time and time again, he’s proved — that’s been my biggest thing with this whole situation. Time and time again, he’s proved that he’s gone to a team and kind of fit the role that he needed to fit. Played less minutes. Did this, did that. So it’d be great for the Knicks.”

Blake Griffin on Chris Paul, Dec 15, 2025. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Kawhi Leonard on Chris Paul
item.description:
Kawhi Leonard on the Clippers parting ways with Chris Paul:

“Surprised at it. He’s always been a willing teammate when I’ve spoke to him. Only thing I could talk about is our conversations. And they’ve always been positive and team-forward. I didn’t have nothing to do with it. I didn’t even know what was going on.”

Kawhi Leonard on Chris Paul, Dec 14, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: John Collins on Chris Paul
item.description:
John Collins on Chris Paul:

“It didn’t workout for whatever reason. But somebody who I looked up to. Wake Forest guy, Clipper legend. Somebody I had a relationship with before I was even drafted. So all love and respect out to my guy CP… Definitely was a lot quieter without him here today. So I’ll leave it at that. Wishing him well in whatever he chooses to do in his next steps.”

John Collins on Chris Paul, Dec 9, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Nicolas Batum on Chris Paul
item.description:
Nicolas Batum on Chris Paul:

“I texted him the first day that happened… I obviously have a ton of respect for him… 21 years and a Hall ofFamer… I got a chance to play with a lot of great players. He’s one of them. So just wanted to text him and thank him for the time I had with him.”

Nicolas Batum on Chris Paul, Dec 9, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: JJ Redick on Chris Paul
item.description:
JJ Redick speaks on Chris Paul’s legacy:

“I hope he doesn’t win an NBA championship because that would mean the Clippers win an NBA championship…That’s who Chris Paul is,he’s the ultimate winner.”

JJ Redick on Chris Paul, Nov 23, 2025. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Chris Paul
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on Chris Paul:

“One of the great point guards in the history of the game…High high level of professionalism he brings. That’s what the great players do.”

Mark Daigneault on Chris Paul, Nov 23, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Chris Paul
item.description:
Tyronn Lue, on Chris Paul’s third straight DNP and what he’s looking for from him:

“Just his leadership. Talking to the guys, talking to the coaches of what he sees, what we can do better. Before we acquired, we told him he wasn’t gonna be an every night guy. He understood that.”

Tyronn Lue on Chris Paul, Nov 13, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Bogdan Bogdanovic on Chris Paul, Bradley Beal
item.description:
Bogdan Bogdanovic:

“It's an honor to play with guys like Bradley Beal, Chris Paul. You can see the experience. They can help us out definitely. I have to say also, the young guys have been training hard. They've been pushing everybody else. We have to give them credit as well.”

Bogdan Bogdanovic on Chris Paul, Bradley Beal, Oct 1, 2025. Source: Twitter @LawMurrayTheNU.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Chris Paul, James Harden
item.description:
Kevin Durant:

“I do see myself signing a contract extension. Ican't tell you exactly when that'll happen, but I do see it happening. Seeing the quick progression of this franchise from where it was right after the James Harden and Chris Paul era… Seeing when Ime [Udoka] got here and how he turned it around so fast—it felt organic and natural. Coming into the gym, getting to be a Houston Rocket for the first time... I’ve always had respect for this coaching staff, this fanbase, this state, this city. So it feels right.”

Kevin Durant on Chris Paul, James Harden, Sep 29, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Sam Presti on Chris Paul, Russell Westbrook
item.description:
Sam Presti:

“Chris Paul is another guy. He's obviously not just a factor in our history but basketball in Oklahoma.. We played Russell in the playoffs. For him to be in the building in these situations, you have to look back on it and take it all in.”

Sam Presti on Chris Paul, Russell Westbrook, Jun 30, 2025. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Jeremy Sochan on Chris Paul
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Jeremy Sochan on Chris Paul playing in all 82 games:

“He could be in flipping, I don't know, Hawaii, doing nothing. And he's here in San Antonio, Texas, busting his ass 82 fucking games,just doing his thing. And I think that's what I've noticed, just the passion that he has.”

Jeremy Sochan on Chris Paul, Apr 13, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: JJ Redick on Chris Paul
item.description:
“(Chris Paul) called me this afternoon and said, ‘Vic and I are gonna go, whether you win or we win, we’re gonna go over and give the boys jerseys,’”

JJ Redick on Chris Paul, Jan 14, 2025. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Victor Wembanyama on Chris Paul
item.description:
A big factor has been the guy who greeted them outside the locker room after the game with high fives, hugs and handshakes.

“I think tonight we for sure went through a stretch that we wouldn't have survived one year ago, and for sure Chris Paul has played a role in that,”

Victor Wembanyama on Chris Paul, Dec 14, 2024. Source: San Antonio Express-News.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Chris Paul, John Stockton
item.description:
“Yes, when you talk about Chris Paul and a lot of the great point guards in this league, to be able to stay up there . . . unfortunately, I didn’t play long enough to catch Stockton, but that number is very impressive when you look at not just the assists, but steals,”

Jason Kidd on Chris Paul, John Stockton, Dec 10, 2024. Source: Dallas Hoops Journal.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on Chris Paul
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Mike Budenholzer on Chris Paul:

“There's the cliche of having a coach on the court, but I don't know that I've seen anybody that it's more true”

Mike Budenholzer on Chris Paul, Dec 3, 2024. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: David Duke on Chris Paul
item.description:
“Chris Paul is a legend, a Hall of Famer, in my opinion, so I am very excited he is going to be here and that I have the chance to pick his brain,”

David Duke on Chris Paul, Jul 30, 2024. Source: San Antonio Express-News.

item.title: Brandin Podziemski on Chris Paul, Stephen Curry
item.description:
“I texted [Chris Paul] yesterday, it was pretty sad… Whether we have stars around Steph [Curry] or we don’t, we’re gonna have to work with it.”

Brandin Podziemski on Chris Paul, Stephen Curry, Jul 1, 2024. Source: Twitter @ClutchPointsApp.

item.title: DeAndre Jordan on Chris Paul
item.description:
DeAndre Jordan on Chris Paul:

“Chris expected a lot out of all of us, and I think people kind of get rubbed the wrong way with that. When you're young, you're kind of like, 'Damn, man, what the [expletive]?'As you get older, you start to understand the game, you start to understand that guys get to a certain point and they want to win a championship. They see these opportunities that they had when they were younger, and they kind of slip away. You don't want those to slip away in the time where you have a great team around you. So it's kind of like, 'I'm not going to do what I did last time and maybe be quiet or let this [expletive] slide.'”

DeAndre Jordan on Chris Paul, Jun 29, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Kyle Filipowski on Chris Paul, LaMarcus Aldridge, Luka Doncic
item.description:
Kyle Filipowski:

“There are players like Chris Paul, Luka, and LaMarcus Aldridge whom I admire for different aspects of their game. Chris Paul for his IQ, Luka Doncic for playing within himself and using his strengths, and LaMarcus Aldridge for his dominance and shooting ability.”

Kyle Filipowski on Chris Paul, LaMarcus Aldridge, Luka Doncic, May 21, 2024. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Chris Paul
item.description:
Warriors head coach Steve Kerr on whether Chris Paul is the last traditional point guard the NBA will see:

“There just aren't many guys like him anymore. I think Steph [Curry] has really influenced a lot of the young point guards in the league now. Shooting the three is a much bigger deal for the modern point guard compared to guys like Chris.”

Steve Kerr on Chris Paul, Mar 13, 2024. Source: Twitter @ClutchPointsApp.

item.title: Klay Thompson on Chris Paul
item.description:
Warriors guardKlay Thompson on pairing with Chris Paul off the bench:

“You've got two Hall of Famers in the backcourt coming off the bench. That's such a rare feat. We take pride in that.”

Klay Thompson on Chris Paul, Feb 28, 2024. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Klay Thompson on Chris Paul
item.description:
Anthony Slater:Klay Thompson:

“Any time Chris Paul speaks, you must listen. I actually watched the Redeem Team documentary last night. It was cool to see a young Chris get rookie hazed.”

Klay Thompson on Chris Paul, Nov 21, 2023. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Chris Paul, Jeremy Sochan
item.description:
Pop on Jeremy Sochan's progression as PG:

“Well it's been 5 or 6 games, and he's not gonna be Chris Paul in 6 games. He's learning a lot and likes the challenge. Every game is an education for him—offense against that pressure is tough. Over time hopefully we'll handle that better.”

Gregg Popovich on Chris Paul, Jeremy Sochan, Nov 6, 2023. Source: reddit.

item.title: Willie Green on Chris Paul
item.description:
Christian Clark:Willie Green on Chris Paul playing for the Warriors:

“I’m sure it’s weird for him. It’s weird for everybody else. But it’s the NBA. It can happen where they can be your opponent, your sort of archenemy, and years later, you can be playing for that organization.”

Willie Green on Chris Paul, Oct 30, 2023. Source: Twitter @cclark_13.

item.title: Jonathan Kuminga on Chris Paul
item.description:
When I asked Kuminga what he’s learning from his time with Paul, he delivered as direct and interesting an answer as I’ve ever heard from him.

“I feel like if you get Chris Paul wide open on a screen, you’re definitely going to be open,”

Jonathan Kuminga on Chris Paul, Oct 20, 2023. Source: The Athletic.
